hypothesis: When the trailing seven-day funding differential between the highest- and lowest-funding major USD-M perpetual exceeds all modeled round-trip friction, a weekly equal-notional short-high/long-low spread earns positive net carry without requiring the outright crypto market direction.
independence: Alpha 005 traded an instrument's own extreme funding as an eight-hour reversal signal. Alpha 009 ranks instruments once per week, holds both opposing legs for seven days, and requires a preregistered carry spread above its friction budget.
data_status: Static five-asset Binance history is project-seen and survivor-biased; development can reject but cannot grant final OOS approval.

official_mechanics.interpretation: positive funding is paid by longs to shorts; historical payments are modeled using contemporaneous mark notional

rules.decision_time: Monday 04:00 UTC using funding timestamps at or before the decision
rules.execution_time: next 1h candle open at Monday 05:00 UTC
rules.score: sum of the prior seven calendar days of funding events

costs.funding: each actual event on contemporaneous mark notional
costs.minimum_spread_reason: 25 bps must cover two legs' round-trip fees and slippage before price-basis risk

observed_result.failed_gate: funding PnL must exceed fees and slippage
observed_result.interpretation: The positive total result came from residual price exposure, primarily SOL and BNB longs, not from the preregistered funding carry edge.

prohibited: opening the locked timerange before the development gate passes
changing the seven-day window, 25bp spread, execution hour, holding period, stops, costs, sizing, or universe after seeing development
dropping a losing leg or asset after seeing results
claiming exact market neutrality from equal notional crypto legs
using leverage to force the monthly target
